title: Space scientist David W. Webb and government awareness of abductions
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Space scientist David W. Webb and government awareness of abductions, about mid-1980s at Strieber's cabin, upstate New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh I was aware by then uh that there were people inside the government who had had a certain amount of contact because I had met uh a space scientist David W. web

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has met non-human beings, says that in the mid-1980s, around the time of experiences at his cabin in upstate New York, he met a space scientist named David W. Webb. According to Strieber, this showed him there were people inside the government who already had some contact with these beings, and he also mentions a researcher named Stanton Friedman. If true, it would mean officials knew about abductions, people being taken by non-humans, well before the public did.
